title: Credits Taken Off a Ridgecrest RxSecure Settlement Figure
content:
Only certain credits standing on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan premium account come off a settlement figure, and which of them do is read from the reason each credit was posted for and from the standing of the enrollment.

1. Where 1 or more credits stand posted on the account for a premium rate changed after the fact, and the enrollment stands in its premium grace period, the credit is worked out by totalling the credits posted on the account for a premium rate changed after the fact.
2. Where no credit stands posted on the account for a premium rate changed after the fact, 1 or more credits stand posted on it for a charge raised in error, and the enrollment stands in its premium grace period, the credit is worked out by totalling the credits posted on the account for a charge raised in error.
3. Where none of that holds, no credit is taken off.

| Credits for a premium rate changed after the fact | Credits for a charge raised in error | Standing of the enrollment | The credit taken off |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 or more | any | in its premium grace period | the total of the rate-change credits |
| none | 1 or more | in its premium grace period | the total of the error-correction credits |
| none | none | in its premium grace period | nothing |
| 1 or more | any | in force or any other footing | nothing |
| none | 1 or more | in force or any other footing | nothing |

The rate-change credits take precedence: where even 1 of them stands on the account the error-correction credits are not reached at all. A credit posted for any other reason is left on the account and is not taken off the settlement.

## Worked on a hypothetical account

Take an account in its premium grace period carrying a credit of 9.00 USD for a premium rate changed after the fact, a credit of 4.00 USD for a charge raised in error, and a credit of 6.00 USD posted because a low-income subsidy applies.

- The credit taken off is 9.00 USD, the total of the rate-change credits alone.
- Had the rate-change credit not been on the account, the credit taken off would be 4.00 USD.
- Had neither been on the account, nothing would be taken off; the 6.00 USD subsidy credit is left on the account whatever else stands there.
- Had the same account stood in force rather than in its premium grace period, nothing would be taken off.
